sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: Bowiea volubilis is a climbing bulbous geophyte native from Uganda to South Africa, often in rocky sites and wooded valleys. The exposed bulb is usually about 5 cm across but can reach around 15 cm. Its branched flowering shoots climb 2 m or more; small greenish-yellow flowers give way to capsules about 15–17 mm long.

sections.title: Toxicity and image
sections.text: The bulb and other parts are poisonous to people and livestock; the common name climbing onion does not mean it is edible. The plate shows the bulb, climbing flower stalk, green flowers and capsule and closely matches the species.
